show.description: Varsh Marwa, heir to a powerful business empire, refuses to become CEO and goes undercover as a peon in his family’s failing Bastar coal company. There, he joins Bhavya, a poor but honest girl, to expose deep-rooted corruption and a coal mafia. Forced into a secret contract marriage to save Bhavya, Varsh hides his identity until it’s revealed at an international summit—uncovering betrayal within his own family and turning his mission into a fight for love, truth, and redemption.
